items.name: AGENTS.md (root)
items.about: Roles, the definition of done, and what needs the owner's yes.
items.text:
# Rules for every agent

## Done means
- every plan criterion passed, with the output attached
- a fresh verifier that did not see your reasoning found no gap
- nothing outside the task changed

## Ask first
Money, messages to people, production, deletions: wait for an explicit **yes**.

@docs/STYLE.md

items.name: STYLE.md
items.text:
# Style

- Small commits, one idea each.
- Tests next to the code they test.
- No new dependency without a line in the PR saying why.

items.name: code-review
items.about: Reviews a diff for correctness, then for simplicity.
items.text:
---
name: code-review
description: Review the current diff for bugs first, style second.
---

# Code review

1. Read the diff and the plan.
2. List correctness problems with file and line.
3. Only then list simplifications.

| Verdict | Meaning |
|---|---|
| pass | no correctness problem found |
| fail | at least one |

items.name: log-papercut
items.fires: when a side defect is noticed
items.about: Records a defect outside the task once, instead of fixing it silently.
items.text:
# Log a papercut

Write one line to the backlog with where you saw it and why it matters. Do not fix it in the current task.
